status: Partial Icarus Dash template: recharge and collision-resolved horizontal displacement; full original movement and Cure branch remain incomplete

known.enhanced_qualification: Heat Rises active OR Song of Flame active while Incinerator Snap is equipped; Celestial Fire alone does not qualify

policies: One persistent uses/progress pair; first use from full resets the meter, later uses retain progress. This reset/start policy requires original-game calibration.

Expansion does not grant free charges; shrink clips uses, retaining progress. Buff or loadout changes apply current 4s/5s rate to later segments. These transition policies require original-game calibration.

Minecraft projection is an immediate collision-resolved horizontal displacement from server yaw. It does not reproduce the original dash animation, velocity curve or movement-input-relative direction.
Heat Rises, Song of Flame, Daybreak and Incinerator Snap are consumed as explicit state/source tags. Test producers use synthetic buffs and a selected melee marker, not complete abilities.
unresolved: Cure x1 from weighted airborne weapon/super kills within five seconds is not implemented by this template.
Original inter-dash lockout, cycle-start timing, mode transition energy grants and Daybreak-specific cooldown/Super cost need calibration.
Full Heat Rises / Song of Flame / Daybreak, subclass/aspect assembly, air-move key, animation, HUD, persistence and cross-loader graphical acceptance remain incomplete.
